title: Today's Rosary | Sunday, October 25, 2026 | Glorious Mysteries
intro_text: Today, October twenty-fifth, we remember Saints Chrysanthus and Daria, martyrs of the early Church in Rome. Saints Chrysanthus and Daria, pray for us.
